content.text: {"core": "Compassion feels what another carries and moves toward it. In Faith, it works on the body that stays still inside not-knowing — the held pose that waits without answers. Overdone, the feeling rushes in and breaks the stillness: the body moves to fix instead of hold, and the waiting collapses into busy hands.", "sheetLine": "The stillness broke; hands moved to fix what only needed holding."}
